title: Two-player own-prior-spell eligibility diagnostic for the Reckless Bushwhacker prerequisite
scope: One new synthetic rules-engine scenario test and bounded test-only qualification/receiving infrastructure on the existing quarantine lineage. Use existing production APIs without modification.
decision: Authorize the two-player test-only eligibility diagnostic. The current grants explicitly exclude eligibility/Surge and the current bounded acceptance is complete.
exclusions: No shipping production or SDK changes, team model, Surge implementation, OGW registration, card snapshots, multiplayer, games/seeds, extra spending or additional worker. No existing test/assertion changes. Reuse prior evidence without requalification.
